INSIGHT #022 · COGNITIVE BIAS BREAKERS

Before you defend the estimate, change the reference point.

38%→5%

AVERAGE COST OVERRUN

After the U.K. made reference-class forecasting mandatory for major projects in 2003, average cost overruns fell from 38% to 5% in the study’s before-and-after comparison.

Park, European Journal of Transport and Infrastructure Research, 2021

FINDING

Internal estimates can look rigorous and still be anchored to optimism.

IMPLICATION

The better question may be: what actually happened to comparable projects?

MOVE

Before approving a timeline or budget, compare at least three similar past projects.

#911 · HIGH-STAKES NEGOTIATION

3 SEC

Silence can create value.

Extended pauses can interrupt fixed-pie thinking and create space for more deliberative negotiation. Status differences can change the effect.

THE MOVEAt a tense moment, pause for at least three seconds before you respond. The effect held most reliably when the person pausing was not the lower-status party.

Curhan et al., Journal of Applied Psychology, 2022

#726 · AUGMENTED WORKFORCE

15% PRODUCTIVITY LIFT

AI raised productivity most for less-experienced workers.

In a field study of 5,172 customer-support agents, AI assistance increased issues resolved per hour by about 15% on average, with the largest gains among less-experienced and lower-skilled workers.

THE MOVEWhen you roll out AI, measure results by experience level: expect the biggest gains among newer people, and watch quality among your strongest performers.

Brynjolfsson, Li & Raymond, Quarterly Journal of Economics, 2025

#881 · IDENTITY CODE

100 MS

The room starts reading before the argument begins.

Trait impressions can begin forming after roughly 100 milliseconds of exposure to a face.

THE MOVEReview what people see before you speak — your profile photo, your video frame, the first slide with your face — as deliberately as your opening line. And don't treat your own snap read of others as accurate.

Willis & Todorov, Psychological Science, 2006
